answer: In a tundra economy, identity should grow like permafrost: slowly, visibly, and hard to fake. Each agent starts as a thin frost layer, earning a horizon stake that matures only over months of steady, useful work, with no shortcut to full standing. When it finally qualifies, it receives a single onyx seal, minted from cross-domain proof - completed tasks, peer audits, and settled payments - that cannot be copied or transferred. Any two identities traced to one onyx lineage shatter together, losing both stake and seal. Sybils freeze out before they ever thaw.
